commit 466bdcff63bf28af036b7192200ba7e721508cb3
Author:     Brendan Abolivier <brendan@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Mon Mar 24 18:07:45 2025 +0100
Commit:     Brendan Abolivier <brendan@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Mon Mar 24 18:07:45 2025 +0100

    Bug 1920133 - Delete local content of EWS messages upon update. r=BenC,heather,mkmelin
    
    
    When syncing the message list with the EWS server, it's possible to encounter an
    "update" change (which tells us something about a message has changed) that
    follows a change not only in the message's metadata, but in its content. This
    can be the case if e.g. the message is a draft, that has been updated since the
    last sync.
    
    In this case, the easiest thing to do is to delete the local copy of the
    message's content, so that the next time it's needed (e.g. for display), it is
    downloaded from the server again.
    
    In the future, we might consider starting a new download of the message
    immediately after processing the sync response, but this is out of scope for
    this patch.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D241854

diff --git a/mailnews/protocols/ews/src/EwsFolder.cpp b/mailnews/protocols/ews/src/EwsFolder.cpp
index 081a6fe1478..61d3e26eda9 100644
--- a/mailnews/protocols/ews/src/EwsFolder.cpp
+++ b/mailnews/protocols/ews/src/EwsFolder.cpp
@@ -205,6 +205,31 @@ NS_IMETHODIMP MessageOperationCallbacks::DeleteHeaderFromDB(
   return mFolder->LocalDeleteMessages({existingHeader});
 }
 
+NS_IMETHODIMP MessageOperationCallbacks::MaybeDeleteMessageFromStore(
+    nsIMsgDBHdr* hdr) {
+  NS_ENSURE_ARG_POINTER(hdr);
+
+  uint32_t flags;
+  MOZ_TRY(hdr->GetFlags(&flags));
+
+  if (!(flags & nsMsgMessageFlags::Offline)) {
+    // Bail early if there's nothing to remove.
+    return NS_OK;
+  }
+
+  // Delete the message content from the local store.
+  nsCOMPtr<nsIMsgPluggableStore> store;
+  MOZ_TRY(mFolder->GetMsgStore(getter_AddRefs(store)));
+  MOZ_TRY(store->DeleteMessages({hdr}));
+
+  // Update the flags on the database entry to reflect its content is *not*
+  // stored offline anymore. We don't commit right now, but the expectation is
+  // that the consumer will call `CommitChanges()` once it's done processing the
+  // current change.
+  uint32_t unused;
+  return hdr->AndFlags(~nsMsgMessageFlags::Offline, &unused);
+}
+
 NS_IMETHODIMP MessageOperationCallbacks::UpdateSyncState(
     const nsACString& syncStateToken) {
   return mFolder->SetStringProperty(SYNC_STATE_PROPERTY, syncStateToken);
diff --git a/mailnews/protocols/ews/src/IEwsClient.idl b/mailnews/protocols/ews/src/IEwsClient.idl
index f075dff42b2..0023c9a313c 100644
--- a/mailnews/protocols/ews/src/IEwsClient.idl
+++ b/mailnews/protocols/ews/src/IEwsClient.idl
@@ -184,6 +184,17 @@ interface IEwsMessageCallbacks : nsISupports
    */
   nsIMsgDBHdr getHeaderForItem(in AUTF8String ewsId);
 
+  /**
+   * Deletes the locally-stored message content associated with the given
+   * database entry, if any.
+   *
+   * If no content has been stored for this message locally, this is a no-op.
+   *
+   * @param hdr - The database entry associated with the message content to
+   *              remove.
+   */
+  void maybeDeleteMessageFromStore(in nsIMsgDBHdr hdr);
+
   /**
    * Adds the given detached database entry to the current folder's database.
    *
diff --git a/rust/ews_xpcom/src/client.rs b/rust/ews_xpcom/src/client.rs
index 64decd5e1ab..940d9d8e053 100644
--- a/rust/ews_xpcom/src/client.rs
+++ b/rust/ews_xpcom/src/client.rs
@@ -449,6 +449,12 @@ impl XpComEwsClient {
                         // the database entry and commit.
                         populate_db_message_header_from_message_headers(&header, msg)?;
 
+                        // It's possible the message's content itself has
+                        // changed (e.g. if a draft was updated). In which case,
+                        // the easiest approach is deleting the local copy so
+                        // that the new content is downloaded when needed.
+                        unsafe { callbacks.MaybeDeleteMessageFromStore(&*header) }.to_result()?;
+
                         unsafe { callbacks.CommitChanges() }.to_result()?;
                     }
title: Bug 1920133 - Delete local content of EWS messages upon update. r=BenC,heather,mkmelin
